record_title: A squarefree theta bound for Clark-Ismail derivative positivity
limitations: The explicit threshold -2 log rho is sufficient but not proved optimal; the smallest failing derivative order below it is not determined; the 2025 correction mentions unspecified slight refinements of 2 log 2; the full Al-Musallam-Bustoz 2006 text was not separately inspected; a differently phrased, unpublished, or poorly indexed stronger bound may exist; independent audit has not been performed.
